purpose: Narrative bridges for arXiv §3; not a statistical sample

core.title: Bump SCRIPT_VERIFY flags to 64 bit
core.point: Consensus surface grows via ad hoc flag/bit expansions without a rule register.

commons.point: Consensus rules live in a numbered register (BLK/TX/SC/…); changes target named rules.

core.point: No production Z3 / spec-lock equivalent in Bitcoin Core.

commons.point: Hundreds of production consensus functions are attribute-locked to the Orange Paper / CONSENSUS_SPEC.

core.title: Update secp256k1 subtree to latest master
core.point: Ongoing C libsecp256k1 subtree maintenance tax.

commons.point: Pure Rust secp256k1 crate; dependency maintenance is Rust-native, not a C subtree.

core.title: Ultraprune: use a pruned-txout-set database for block validation
core.point: Foundational UTXO storage redesign to make validation tractable — architectural debt compensation.

commons.point: UTXO commitments and parallel IBD are designed subsystems, not after-the-fact storage rescues.

core.title: init: fix reindex deadlock by waking cv after interrupt
core.point: Lock/concurrency patches around IBD/reindex remain a recurring tax.

commons.point: Parallel IBD engine isolates sync concurrency as a first-class module.

core.title: net: Replace libnatpmp with built-in PCP+NATPMP implementation
core.point: Legacy stack evolves via net/ transport and NAT patches.

commons.point: Multiple transports (Iroh/TCP/Dandelion/Erlay) coexist under one network layer.

core.title: rpc/wallet: add simulaterawtransaction RPC
core.point: New capability often lands as another RPC on the shared bitcoind surface (RPC high-debt subsystem).

commons.point: Extensions are process-isolated modules with manifests, not growth of a single RPC monolith.

core.title: p2p: improve TxOrphanage denial of service bounds
core.point: CPU/memory DoS bounds patched into orphanage on the existing net_processing design.

commons.point: DoS/bandwidth protections are dedicated network components alongside transports.

core.title: [kernel 3a/n] Decouple CTxMemPool from ArgsManager
core.point: Years-long kernel extraction: peeling globals from a monolith after the fact.

commons.point: Layer separation is the starting architecture (volatility gradient), not a retrofit.

core.point: No first-class selective-sync module equivalent in Core.

commons.point: Selective sync ships as a satellite module with module.toml isolation.

limitations: Pairs are illustrative, not randomly sampled
Core PR categories from Phase 1 classification (tiers 1–3)
Absence of a Core PR does not prove impossibility — it marks a design asymmetry
